release_selection: Latest published stable release verified on the check date; not an old GitHub mirror.
led_unit_count: Confirmed by the original WACCA Reverse DLL: first DWORD is the number of color entries and output length is count*12 encoded bytes. 480 is a full ring; actual game counts need runtime capture.

controller_usb_led_frame.status: Planned; custom mercuryio.dll bridge and MCU LED_FRAME receiver are not implemented
controller_usb_led_frame.conversion: Keep the 1924-byte SegaTools RGBA callback ABI; validate unitCount and discard each A byte before USB framing. The count field is not part of the LED_FRAME payload.

led_source_review.delivery: Inline in-process callback; no USB encoding, color conversion, replication or rate limiter in the hook.
led_source_review.default_callback: Empty; physical LED output requires a custom IO implementation.
led_source_review.first_argument: Original DLL processes argument 0; arguments >=1 return without LED output. SegaTools discards this argument. Actual game argument values remain unmeasured.
led_source_review.alpha_policy: The original WACCA Reverse USBIntLED.DLL ignores byte 3 (A) in its physical LED conversion. Retain A only for diagnostics; do not apply it as brightness or white.
led_source_review.cadence: One callback per intercepted game call; exact game call frequency not measured.

original_native_driver.physical_channels: GRB only; input A byte ignored
original_native_driver.evidence: Frame loop reads 32-bit RGBA at 4+4*i; encoder extracts only bits 0-7, 8-15, 16-23 and writes 12 bytes per LED.
